grading.concept_groups: A list of required groups. A group is satisfied if ANY phrase in it appears in the answer (case-insensitive; hyphens/underscores read as spaces; thousands separators removed; whole-token boundaries).
grading.strict_all_hops: Answerable: 1 only if not refused/abstained, the final answer passes the citation gate, and 100% of concept_groups are satisfied. Out-of-scope: 1 only if the system refuses or abstains.
grading.hop_count: Number of distinct facts that must be combined (usually spread over different chunks and often different papers).
grading.pathway_agnostic: Routes and templates are logged for diagnostics but never graded.
